name: Repair a broken hire wrapper import: the preserved .claude/commands/awos/hire.md points at a command body this project does not have, so a removal notice is written there (an existing local hire command is left untouched and keeps working)

content: `/awos:hire` was removed in AWOS 2.0. AWOS no longer provisions agents: they come from the host's own ecosystem (project `.claude/agents/` files and plugins). (This notice was written because your preserved command wrapper pointed at a file this project did not have — there was no local copy of the old command to keep working.)
Tell the user the following, then stop. Do not create or install any agent files.

- This command no longer ships with AWOS. Staffing is handled on the path: `/awos:tasks` surfaces a staffing gap as an open question when no installed agent covers a task, and `/awos:implement` falls back to `general-purpose` and reports the substitution.
- Agents previously installed under `.claude/agents/` are theirs to keep or delete.
- To remove this notice, delete `.claude/commands/awos/hire.md` and `.awos/commands/hire.md`.
